Law enforcement is searching for two girls last seen Wednesday in Centennial, according to alerts from the Colorado Bureau of Investigation.

Auraelia Garcia, 11, and 14-year-old Paityn Maul were last seen late Wednesday night in the 5300 block of South Truckee Court in Centennial, according to investigators. They are believed to be with each other, according to alerts from CBI.

Auraelia is described as a 5-foot, 120-pound girl with brown hair and brown eyes, according to her alert. She was last wearing a black hoodie and black pants.

Activation – 11-yoa Auraelia Garcia, last seen on July 29, 2026, at 11:00pm, in the 5300 block of S Truckee Ct in Centennial. She is believed to be with 14-yoa Paityn Maul (separate alert issued). Law enforcement is concerned for their safety. If seen, please call 9-1-1. pic.twitter.com/IbjPUUzO5w

— CBI (@CBI_Colorado) July 30, 2026

Paityn is described as a 4-foot-11-inch, 120-pound girl with brown hair and blue eyes, her alert stated. She was last wearing a black hoodie and black shorts.

Activation – 14 yoa Paityn Maul last seen July 29, 2026, at 11:00pm in the 5300 block of S Truckee Ct in Centennial. She is believed to be with 11-yoa Auraelia Garcia (separate alert issued for Auraelia). Law enforcement is concerned for their safety. If seen, please call 9-1-1 pic.twitter.com/iVMKJKVRc6

— CBI (@CBI_Colorado) July 30, 2026

Anyone who sees the two girls is asked to contact the Arapahoe County Sheriff’s Office at 303-795-4711.
